verdict.rationale: The bizfile portal lets users search business records, view more than 17 million filed entity images, and print copies of formation, amendment and Statement of Information filings. Certificates of status, apostille issuance and certified copies can also be verified online. Together these let a founder confirm that a filing was recorded and check entity status. However, nothing in the evidence shows a public tracker for a pending filing, application or case, such as a submission queue, processing-status lookup or work-order status page. Missing for 10: an explicit status lookup for in-process filings or applications, documented processing-time or queue visibility, and hands-on corroboration of the status lookup flow.
